folds.body:
All nineteen F rows, C1–C4 and BL coverage were read. The strongest historical counterexamples are specific: F09’s queued mixture yields one batch at clock9 versus three through3/6/9; F11’s retained terminal event historyRef can outlive its pin; F06 chooses causal target from the first inventory delta. Their original proofs are source/synthetic at recorded inputs, not current reproduced natural defects. The ordinary traveler’s additional pins limit F11 reachability, and a detached rejected plan is not established live-save corruption. Eight passing probes reproduced eight observations; they did not fix or native-play them (AD32/AD36).

Preserve the audit’s controls and distinctions. F02 already states native seededRecipe/random callbacks, so raw helper defaults do not establish the native defect mistakenly inferred in B145. F13’s future-version error can be masked, yet rejection still precedes storage writes. F14’s transaction abort differs from diegetic rewind retaining RNG/receipts; do not restore RNG globally as a supposed correction. Ordinary JSON roundtrip preserves the relevant key order; Map/Set admission is latent if introduced, and canonical mixture IDs intentionally encode ordered fields. F08 explicitly retains authored array order inside source-event phases rather than universally sorting narratives by ID. Floating arithmetic alone does not demonstrate cross-engine divergence.

Do not regenerate retained truths/people or silently change selected draw distributions; any changed hash/order interpretation needs an explicit supported revision.
